description:
Search documents. Returns ranked results with title, author, year, description, url, id, score — not full content. Use URLs from results with fetch/browsing to read actual documents.

Use when: user asks to research, find papers/books/articles, look up facts, find discussions, legal cases, or any "search for..." request.

Strategy: use 2-4 keywords per query (English preferred). Pick the right type first. Try synonyms if few results. Search across multiple types to cross-reference. Use detail() for full metadata on promising results.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token. Use next_cursor from previous response.

limit.description: Results to return (1-50). Trial max 10, Pro max 50.

query.description: Search query — use 2-4 keywords for best results. English preferred unless searching non-English content. Try different keywords and synonyms if first attempt returns few results.

type.description: Content type (required). academic: OpenAlex/arXiv/Semantic Scholar/DBLP | wiki: Wikipedia 18 languages | books: books/digital libraries | legal: Case Law/CourtListener/EUR-Lex | forums: HN/StackExchange/Lobsters/LessWrong/60+ | economics: World Bank/IMF/FRED | packages: npm/PyPI/Crates.io | knowledge: Wikidata | news: news articles | music: Discogs/MusicBrainz | video: IMDb/YouTube | health: clinical trials | geo: world places | fandom: fan wikis | tech: Dev.to | audio: podcasts | social: Reddit/Mastodon/Lemmy | crypto: DeFi/tokens | predictions: prediction markets.

name: search
